programs.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
programs.desc: Eivin and August construct a unique hay baler that will take a load off their backs -- if it doesn't set them on fire first  the family travels to the Copper River to dip net for red salmon  Charlotte and Otto celebrate 25 years of marriage.

programs.title: Dirty Mudder Truckers: The Dirty 7 vs. South Carolina
programs.desc: Team South Carolina heads down to Florida to challenge the Dirty Seven  with both money and pride on the line, it's a scramble to get the trucks ready in time to race  drivers have to push their motors to the limit and battle it out in The Pit.

programs.title: Bering Sea Gold
programs.desc: Shawn's rival Ken unleashes his 600-ton gold gobbler while Shawn fights to keep a family dynasty  Vernon makes a valiant return in an attempt to strike it rich with a new dredge, and Emily fights to reclaim her hotspot.

programs.title: America's Worst Tattoos: He Spelled My Kids' Names Wrong!
programs.desc: Tackling the misplaced anger of a client  a client requests a biomechanical panel.

programs.title: Breaking Point: Belgaum Commando School
programs.desc: Soldiers continue training at commando school where they slide down 30-foot high platforms, wade through drains, navigate a hostile jungle and finish one of the toughest obstacle courses in the world.

programs.title: Incredible Engineering Blunders: Fixed
programs.desc: Justin climbs on top of a stadium roof that is held up by air and in danger of collapse  checking out a new fleet of submarines that are too heavy to float.
